'''Raurlu Eloz''' was an individual from [[Glakka]]. When a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] operative, posing as a Glakka merchant, approached [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|ISB]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Jeffren Brek]], he was asked if he knew Raurlu Eloz or [[Zoort]]. When Brek received a negative response, he was easily able to deduce that he was in fact dealing with a Rebel spy.

==Behind the scenes==
Judging by Brek's behavior, it is likely that Raurlu Eloz was a factual individual, although he could still be a part of Brek's ruse.
